title: Matching in distributed LOCAL
coverage: Curated primary-source comparison of fourteen general-graph results, plus separately scoped CONGEST and regular-graph results. Targeted searches through 2026-10-20 include 2025 maximality lower bounds and the May/September 2026 preprints shown here. This is not an exhaustive list of all graph classes, approximation ratios, success notions, or historical refinements.
defaultScope: General graphs on n nodes with maximum degree Δ. Synchronous LOCAL rounds, unbounded message size; distributed matching output. Maximality and approximation are separate tasks.

facets.label: Approximate maximum matching; quality and weight scope stated per point

definitions.local: Each vertex is a processor; communication is along graph edges in synchronous rounds with unbounded messages.
definitions.lca: Local computation algorithms answer graph-probe queries; their probe cost is not LOCAL communication rounds.
definitions.maximal: No edge can be added to M. This implies |M|≥OPT/2 but is strictly stronger than the approximation guarantee alone.
definitions.weighted: Compare total matching weight, not just number of matched edges. Unit weights recover cardinality.
definitions.quality: An α-approximation for a maximization problem means value(M)≥OPT/α; expectation and high-probability guarantees are distinct.
definitions.axes: X records deterministic/randomized. Y records exact symbolic round formulas; rows are categorical and do not supply hidden constants.

maximal.note: Both Balliu lower bounds and KS25 remain in view because their degree regimes differ.

approximation.note: Weighted, unweighted, expected, and high-probability guarantees are stated individually. No region is shaded across incomparable contracts.
